listing.name: Rebalanced Doom
listing.summary: Rebalances the Doom ship by reducing its mine range and removing mine deployment during phase, making it less overpowered and riskier to use.
listing.aiSummary: Rebalances the Doom ship by reducing its mine range and removing mine deployment during phase, making it less overpowered and riskier to use.

descriptionHtml:
DownloadCan be added during a campaign.
Can be safely removed from a campaign.
Affects the Starlight Cabal Doom from Underworld as well.

Active changes
  • Removes the ability to deploy mines while phasing.
  • Reduces the range of the mine strike system from 1500 to 800.


Goal of the mod
  • Make the Doom less annoying to play against and less overpowered to play as.
  • Make it harder and riskier to use well.
  • Keep its core identity as a backstabbing ship intact.
  • Make sure that the AI is able to use the changed ship well.
  • Do it with as few changes as possible.


Footage of the changes in action

No skills and normal loadout.

Optimized loadout with skills against 2 radiant remnant fleet.
aiDescription: Rebalances the Doom ship by reducing its mine range from 1500 to 800 and removing the ability to deploy mines while phasing. This makes the ship less overpowered when played and less annoying to face, while preserving its core identity as a backstabbing vessel. The changes are designed to make it harder to use effectively and ensure the AI can still utilize it well.
